exercises.question: It is necessary that we act so that the problem does not get worse. Which sentence says this?
options: Es necesario que actuemos para que el problema no se agrave. [It is necessary that we act so that the problem does not get worse.]
Es necesario que actuamos para que el problema no se agrave. [It is necessary that we (indicative) act so that the problem does not get worse.]
Es necesario que actuemos para que el problema no se agrava. [It is necessary that we act so that the problem (indicative) does not get worse.]

exercises.sentence: Es importante que __ la causa del problema.
exercises.english: It is important that we address the cause of the problem.
The authorities need to prevent new breakdowns.

sentences: Primero, es necesario que actuemos a tiempo. [First, it is necessary that we act in time.]
Después, es importante que abordemos la causa del problema. [Then it is important that we address the cause of the problem.]
Finalmente, conviene que se adopten medidas antes del invierno. [Finally, it is advisable that measures be adopted before winter.]

exercises.question: Which form follows «Hace falta que»? [¿Qué forma sigue a «Hace falta que»?]
options: prevengan [prevent (subjunctive)]
previenen [prevent (indicative)]
prevenir [to prevent]

exercises.sentence: Conviene que se __ medidas antes del invierno.
exercises.english: It is advisable that measures be adopted before winter.
It is necessary that we act so that the problem does not get worse.

exercises.sentence: Es necesario que actuemos para que el problema no se agrave.
options: It is necessary that we act so that the problem does not get worse.
We should wait quietly until the problem gets worse.
The problem has already been solved by the authorities.

exercises.sentence: Hace falta que las autoridades prevengan nuevas averías.
options: The authorities need to prevent new breakdowns.
The authorities caused new breakdowns.
The authorities ignored the problem.

exercises.sentence: Es importante que abordemos la causa del problema.
exercises.english: It is important that we address the cause of the problem.

exercises.sentence: Conviene que se adopten medidas antes del invierno.
options: It is advisable that measures be adopted before winter.
Measures should only be adopted afterwards.
There is no need for measures.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué debemos hacer para que el problema no empeore?

options: Es necesario que actuemos a tiempo. [It is necessary that we act in time.]
Es necesario que actuamos a tiempo. [It is necessary that we (indicative) act in time.]
Es necesario que actuaríamos a tiempo. [It is necessary that we would act in time.]
Hace falta que prevengan nuevas averías. [The authorities need to prevent new breakdowns.]
Hace falta que previenen nuevas averías. [The authorities (indicative) prevent new breakdowns.]
Hace falta que prevenirán nuevas averías. [The authorities will prevent new breakdowns.]
Es importante que abordemos la causa del problema. [It is important that we address the cause of the problem.]
Es importante que abordamos la causa del problema. [It is important that we (indicative) address the cause of the problem.]
Es importante que abordaríamos la causa del problema. [It is important that we would address the cause of the problem.]

template.prompt: Say that it is necessary for us to act in time and to prevent new breakdowns.
template.answer: Es necesario que actuemos a tiempo y que prevengamos nuevas averías.

template.prompt: Say that it is important to address the cause of the problem in order to prevent new breakdowns.
template.answer: Es importante que abordemos la causa del problema para prevenir nuevas averías.
